method.s: Trim beef, season with salt and pepper, then sear all sides over medium-high heat in oil until browned (about 2 minutes per side). Set aside.
Combine cayenne, cumin, paprika, garlic, beef stock, tomato paste, jalapeño and lime juice.
Transfer beef and diced onion into slow cooker. Pour liquid mixture over.
Cook in slow cooker on low for 6 - 8 hours or high for 3 - 4 hours. (Low heat is better if you have time.)
Shred beef with two forks and toss to coat with the juices.
Serve hot in a tortilla bowl with cheese, guacamole, salsa cruda, and sour cream or plain Greek yoghurt.
If it cools, a layer of fat will form - might like to skim this off.
